description: B500S-83D is a Xingtai compact two-stage manual/electric pump listing 7.5 kW, 380 V, 5 m delivery height, 5 m horizontal, 915 × 550 × 550 mm, 280 kg, short boom on the compact unit, sand and small stone 5–16 mm. It does not print m³/h. It is not Electric 10, not a truck-mounted placing boom and not the mini-access article. Match the sheet, then inquire.

answerBlock.what: B500S-83D Two-Stage Structure Pump is a compact two-stage manual/electric pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: 7.5 kW, 380 V, 5 m delivery height, 5 m horizontal, standard delivery hose, 915 × 550 × 550 mm, 280 kg. The listed short boom is part of this compact unit; it is not a truck-mounted placing boom. Applicable materials: sand and small stone 5–16 mm. No m³/h cell is printed.
answerBlock.who: Buyers placing sand or 5–16 mm small stone inside 5 m height and 5 m horizontal with 380 V, who accept a 280 kg wheeled compact unit.
factors: 7.5 kW / 380 V versus Electric 10 at 15 kW / 21 m³/h theoretical / 25 m
5 m / 5 m reach — not Electric 15’s 15–20 m vertical
Materials 5–16 mm sand and small stone; no m³/h on the sheet
Short boom on the compact unit, not a truck placing boom

faqs.question: Does the B500S-83D sheet print hopper litres like Electric 10’s 0.1 m³?
faqs.answer: No. B500S-83D lists 7.5 kW, 380 V, 5 m / 5 m, 280 kg and 5–16 mm materials. Hopper litres are not on that sheet. Electric 10 lists hopper 0.1 m³.

faqs.question: Is the short boom a truck-mounted placing boom?
faqs.answer: No. ACI PRC-304.2-17 separates trailer pumps from truck-mounted pumps. The B500S-83D boom is listed on the compact unit. Pinjin does not sell a boom-pump SKU.

faqs.question: Can B500S-83D place Electric 40’s 21 m³/h fine stone at 120 m?
faqs.answer: No. Horizontal delivery on this sheet is 5 m. Fine-stone 120 m / 360 m belongs to [Electric 40](/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/).
